children: US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said Tuesday he wants Congress to approve another $30 billion for air traffic control towers and software and airports.
Congress approved $12.5 billion last year but Duffy has sought billions more. He upped his request on Tuesday to add another $10 billion for airports.
